## 19.1 An outline first

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- We ask the AI for an outline, not for finished slides.
- A good prompt gives the topic, the audience, the length, the form and a limit.
- We never put personal data into a prompt.
- **Lab task:** Write an outline prompt for your talk. Which five parts does it have?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/outline-prompt.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · The prompt

a) Which part of the prompt is "12 office staff, not technical"?
b) Which part of the prompt is "5 slides, about 3 minutes"?
c) What must never go into the prompt?

::: {.answer}
a) the audience
b) the length
c) personal data, such as names and phone numbers
:::

## 19.2 From the outline to slides

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- View › Outline shows the text of all slides.
- A line at the left edge becomes a new slide.
- Tab makes a line a point, and Shift+Tab makes it a title.
- **Lab task:** Paste your outline into Outline view. How many slides do you get?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/outline-view.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 2 · Outline view

a) Where do we find Outline view?
b) Which key makes a line a point of the slide above?
c) What happens when a point is at the left edge?

::: {.answer}
a) View › Outline
b) Tab
c) It becomes its own slide.
:::

## 19.3 Pictures with AI

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An image prompt has a subject, a style, a setting, colours and a shape.
- We ask for no text, because AI writes wrong letters.
- We never make pictures of real people.
- **Lab task:** Make one picture and check it. Which errors did you find?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/ai-pictures.png)
:::
::::

## Example · A picture for "The plan"

Huda's first prompt "a picture of our company" gives a sign with "SUNRSIE CMOPANY".
**How does Huda get a better picture?**

::: {.reveal}
1. The new prompt is **an office desk with a laptop and folders, flat, orange and white, 16:9, no text**.
2. The picture fits the theme and has **no letters** to get wrong.
3. It gets **alt text** and the note **"Picture: AI-generated"**.
:::

## Try it 3 · Pictures

a) Why do we ask for no text in an AI picture?
b) Which shape fits a picture next to the points?
c) What is often a better choice than an AI picture?

::: {.answer}
a) AI tools often write wrong letters.
b) wide 16:9
c) a stock image or our own photo
:::

## 19.4 Check before you present

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- We compare every number with our real data.
- We open every source and delete made-up ones.
- We say in a short note what the AI did.
- **Lab task:** Check your talk. What did you change?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/check-deck.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/ai-deck-check.html" poster="sims/ai-deck-check.png" title="AI Deck Check: ready for Monday?" kind="game" task="**The story:** Huda made the talk Going paperless with AI help. **Play:** check each slide and prompt, and choose the best action before the Monday meeting." >}}

## Try it 4 · The best action (harder)

a) What do we do with a number from the AI that our notes do not show?
b) What do we do with a source that we cannot find?
c) How do we tell the audience that AI helped?

::: {.answer}
a) We correct it from the real data.
b) We delete it.
c) with a short note, such as "Outline and pictures made with AI help"
:::

## Summary

- We ask for an outline with a topic, an audience, a length, a form and a limit.
- Outline view turns the lines into slides.
- Image prompts have five parts, and we check every AI picture.
- We check numbers, sources and the amount of text.
- We say honestly what the AI did.
